description: Semantic search over LLM session summary chunks with M17 StrEnum-typed filters. Returns top-k summaries joined to their sessions, ordered by embedding cosine similarity descending (pgvector ANN over the summary-vector index). Filters: query (required, natural-language); limit (1..50, default 10); vendor (optional SourceVendor StrEnum: codex / claude_code / agent_messaging / chatgpt); source_kind (optional IngestSourceKind StrEnum: e.g. claude_code_local, codex_state, codex_ambient); since (optional ISO-8601 lower bound on session.last_event_at, UTC, timezone-aware required). The vendor / source_kind / since filters narrow the ANN result set after similarity ranking. M18 dedupe-aware: only canonical session rows have summary chunks (M6 only summarizes canonical), so result set is automatically dedup'd across CODEX_LOCAL / CODEX_STATE / CODEX_HISTORY / CODEX_GOALS / CODEX_AMBIENT sibling sources.
embedding_description: Semantic search past LLM sessions by query against the session ledger summary index with optional vendor (SourceVendor enum: codex, claude_code, agent_messaging, chatgpt), source_kind (IngestSourceKind enum), and since (ISO-8601 cutoff) filters. M18 cross-source dedupe — one canonical row per logical session.
